result: For every prime p there are spaces admitting A_(p−1) structures but no A_p structure. The proof's Moore space with reduced homology Z_(p) in degree2n−1 works for n prime to p(p−1); p=5,n=3 yields a homotopy-associative space not of loop-space homotopy type. The examples and techniques are explicitly credited to J.F.Adams.
